title: Rental Tenure Uplift on Late Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Claim Payments
content:
**Clause.** On an approval paid late under a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan, the tenure uplift adds interest of the outstanding approved amount multiplied by the uplift and by the payment's late days, divided by 365. The tenure uplift is 0.02 a year when the covered rental's move-in date is 60 or more whole months before the handling date and the rental's ledger shows no rent payment reversal in the 12 whole months before the handling date, 0.01 when the move-in date is at least 24 and fewer than 60 whole months before the handling date and the ledger shows no such reversal, and nothing otherwise.

**Records read.** The covered Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement: its move-in date and its tenant ledger.

| Whole months from move-in to the handling date | Rent payment reversal in the 12 whole months before the handling date | Uplift (a year) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 60 or more | none | 0.02 |
| 24 to 59 | none | 0.01 |
| fewer than 24 | any | nothing |
| any | one or more | nothing |

**Boundary (hypothetical).** 60 whole months with a clean ledger takes 0.02, 59 takes 0.01, 24 takes 0.01 and 23 takes nothing.
